_desc: Rotating quote card rendered above the footer on every page (reference feature). Quotes auto-rotate with a smooth fade; add/remove items freely — the rotation adapts. Toggled via config.json features.quotes; rotation interval in seconds below.
_sources: Seeded with the reference portfolio's own quote list (ramxcodes/sleek-portfolio src/config/Quote.ts, MIT) so the section works out of the box — replace with your own favorites anytime.

_fields.intervalSeconds: How long each quote stays before fading to the next.
